question: Which unit was afraid of flying and compensated by excelling at ground maintenance?

reference_quotes.text: The navitech automaton was stationed in the Belanor Sanctuary on the moon Lorumon 4 where it excelled at ground maintenance in order to compensate for a programming glitch that meant it was afraid of flying, meaning it was not assigned starfighter duty.

question: Which medical assistant could use twenty retractable manipulator arms simultaneously?

reference_quotes.text: The automatons ability to use its twenty retractable manipulator arms simultaneously proved useful to an understaffed medical bay.

question: Which unit harassed a trooper by locking doors and running over their feet?

reference_quotes.text: Orulin-53 was an navitech automaton who served onboard the Kelaelen Promise II battle station in 4 ACE. The automaton regularly made trouble for the armored trooper Beleran-55, locking them out of their quarters, running over their feet, and even threatening them with an arc welder.

question: Which droid was built into a light interceptor and had only a domed head instead of a full body?

reference_quotes.text: The Ororis-series navitech automaton Oreven-43 was integrated into Oreolen Galeotor's Valiran-51 light interceptor starfighter as his navigator and copilot, and therefore only possessed a dome head instead of a full body.

question: Which droid was considered its pilot's good luck charm and remained in the palace hangar during the invasion?

reference_quotes.text: During the invasion of the planet Ithinor by the Heleoris Trade League, it served as the personal navitech unit of Loreoran Oraedan, who considered his navitech a good luck charm.

question: What was the purpose of Darutor-41's mission to the planet Zelenor?
expected_answer: To fly his Helelen interceptor back to the Seleven Dawn to report to Commander Itharis Fenutor and prepare the Daraemir Assault Battalion for the Battle of Zelenor.

reference_quotes.text: "Take the fighter back to the ship. Tell Itharis Fenutor I've made contact." ―Coreris Elaemon to Darutor-41

question: On which superweapon was Daritor-90 stationed?
expected_answer: Daritor-90 was stationed on the Kelaelen Promise II superweapon.

reference_quotes.text: Daritor-90 was an Helevekian modified Meralin-48 navitech automaton stationed on board the Kelaelen Promise II superweapon while the battle station was under construction in the Ithovek system.

question: Where did Selivek-75 live?
expected_answer: Selivek-75 lived in Kelosil spaceport on the planet Elanor.

reference_quotes.text: They lived in Kelosil spaceport on the planet Elanor

question: Which Meralin-48 navitech automaton manufactured by Oriadan Automatics served in the Valovek Coalition's Kelaenor Group during the Pelomon Civil War?

reference_quotes.text: Loraven-56 was an Meralin-48 navitech automaton manufactured by Oriadan Automatics that served in the Valovek Coalition's Kelaenor Group during the Pelomon Civil War.

question: Whom did Dareoran-93 greet during the blockade of Ithinor in 32 BCE?
expected_answer: Dareoran-93 greeted the Zeliadan Commonwealth ambassadors.

reference_quotes.text: It was she who greeted the Zeliadan Commonwealth ambassadors (secretly Nelivekari Master Meruven Galanor and his apprentice, Coreris Elaemon) during the blockade of Ithinor in 32 BCE.

question: What was Helaetor-20 specially programmed to do?
expected_answer: plot sublight tactical courses for starships

reference_quotes.text: Specially programmed to plot sublight tactical courses for starships, Helaetor-20 played an invaluable role during the Battle of Loraetor in 3 ACE by assisting Pelosil in planning evacuation routes from Nelamir Base.
